success.title: Back from checkout
success.description: Open the Histae app to check whether your subscription is active. Confirmation may take a few moments.

cancel.title: Want to come back later?
cancel.description: You can return to Histae to check your subscription and explore the available plans whenever you like.

return.title: Find your subscription in Histae
return.description: After visiting the Stripe portal, return to the app to check your subscription and any changes you made.

steps.app: Return to the Histae app on your phone.
steps.subscription: From your profile, open the subscription screen (« Mon abonnement »).
steps.refresh: If needed, tap the verification button (« Vérifier mon abonnement ») to refresh your status.

billing.note: Check the Histae app for confirmation and your current subscription status.
